adopt: Give one agent a memory scoped to one project and watch it stop re-asking.
description:
Kind: tool

Problem
An agent that forgets everything between sessions re-derives the same facts forever; one that remembers everything globally leaks context across projects.

Install
pip install awm

Commands
  awm

Quick start
  pip install awm
  
  awm remember --scope acme:alice:orchestrator --key recipe --value "rank 16, lr 2e-5"
  awm recall --scope acme:alice:orchestrator

Docs
https://aitherium.github.io/awm/
